## Personality

Phillips is known for being a horrid and sarcastic individual. He is also an ineffective disciplinarian who lacks control, relying on constant corporal punishment without maintaining any real order.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Phillips served as the master of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, where he struggled to maintain order despite resorting constantly to whipping his pupils, a position he had secured through the influence of his uncle who was a trustee. While boarding at the home of Eben Wright, he taught local children including [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) broke a slate over Gilbert's head in response to a taunt, Phillips punished her temper by making her stand at the blackboard with a humiliating message.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as the schoolmaster in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) is one of his students. He oversees the classroom dynamic and enforces discipline among the pupils, including penalizing [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her outburst against [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), +2 more_
